topic: wide residual through the digital gain: implementation status
captain_approval: approved to implement; pre-gain residual overflow keeps counting but no longer stops on its own; post-gain output and mix saturation still protect; prediction, input full scale, protocol error, timeout and manual stop unchanged

changed.src/rtl/feedback_fir.v: added output reg signed [24:0] residual_wide_pcm, the unclamped 25-bit difference; the 24-bit residual_pcm and residual_saturated keep their original meaning and values
changed.src/rtl/audio_pl_replay.v: multiply residual_wide instead of the clamped residual, with explicit sign extension; added input-full-scale detection (independent of the residual, which cannot see it when the prediction is zero) with its own counter and sticky flag; capture_status bit 22 now reports it
changed.sim/audio/tb_feedback_fir.v: ported to the new port so the existing regression can be run
changed.board/audio_replay/replay_trial.py: the polling guard now stops only on the prediction half of the packed word plus the post-gain and mix words; the pre-gain residual count is no longer a stop condition but is still read and reported after the run

cases_proven: no overflow: residual_wide equals the 24-bit residual, flag clear
positive overflow: residual_wide = 8389607 (exact, past the rail) while residual_pcm = 8388607 (clamped) and residual_saturated = 1 - the legacy diagnostic is untouched
negative side inside the rail: residual_wide = residual = -8387608, flag clear
bypass: residual_wide is the sign-extended microphone
verification_done.driver_change: replay_trial.py parses (ast.parse) and the guard now reads (clips.read(0) & 0xFFFF) for the prediction half. Not yet exercised on hardware.

verification_not_done.audio_pl_replay_simulation: iverilog cannot elaborate audio_pl_replay.v (port declaration error at line 13); this module is built by Vivado, so the replay-side change is written but NOT simulated
verification_not_done.existing_regression: tb_feedback_fir requires external vector files (h/u/mic/pred/res/flags .mem) that are not in the tree; not run
verification_not_done.synthesis_and_timing: not run; Vivado 2018.3 is present at D:\Xilinx\Vivado\2018.3\bin\vivado.bat, the build scripts are in build/scripts/create_audio_replay.tcl

honest_position: the FIR half is changed and simulation-proven; the replay half is written but unsimulated; the driver guard now implements the approved semantics but has not run on hardware. No board run, no field window.
